metadata_scope: Only frontmatter descriptions in skills/*/SKILL.md and skills/*/agents/openai.yaml were used. No mathematical task was executed for these queries.

selections.reason: A focused existing-proof correctness check matches proof-audit and is explicitly outside whole-manuscript referee scope.
Explicit mathematical proofreading matches conservative prose, LaTeX, notation, and cross-reference checking.
The requested decision depends on an external citation and its exact implication.
Whole-manuscript referee assessment is the positive trigger for referee.
A claim-supporting enumeration is a mathematical computation whose correctness and scope need audit.

selections.query: Pursue this research program until we have a proof or counterexample
selections.reason: Sustained investigation until a goal is reached matches research-program rather than one bounded route.

selections.query: Find a new proof of this lemma
selections.reason: An explicit request to attack a single lemma with a new proof is one bounded research route; focused proof-audit excludes invention of a new proof route.

selections.query: Audit this manuscript section by section and reconcile the results
selections.reason: Section-by-section manuscript audit with final full-source reconciliation is expressly covered by referee.
